The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/frasbl/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in French, Sainte Bible Libre pour le monde translation
> Public Domain
> Language: français (French)
> Translation by: David Williams
> Contributor: Michael Paul Johnson
> Domaine Public
> Il s'agit d'un brouillon de traduction. Il est en cours de relecture et d'édition. Si vous trouvez des erreurs, veuillez nous en informer à https://eBible.org/cgi-bin/contact.cgi.
> This is a draft translation. It is being proofread and edited. If you find errors, please let us know at https://eBible.org/cgi-bin/contact.cgi.
> 2026-10-13

What was found:
Text: a draft French translation by David Williams with Michael Paul Johnson, dated 2026-10-13.

Why it stays out: missing fact: a public-domain dedication in the translator David Williams's own words (the source text is the World English Bible: the French Mark 16:9 footnote translates the World English Bible's and names it).

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=frasbl), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/frasbl/copyright.htm), https://ebible.org/details.php?id=frasbl.
